storylines.storyline_label: Feast ML feature-store ships maximum-severity unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-56121, CVSS 9.3, gRPC registry dill.loads() before authz; fixed in Feast 0.63.0)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact (June 24, covered June 26 as top lead): CVE-2026-56121, an unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaw in the Feast open-source ML feature store, rated CVSS 9.3 (v4.0) / 9.8 (v3.1), fixed in 0.63.0. The registry server base64-decodes the user_defined_function.body of an OnDemandFeatureView and passes it to dill.loads() before any authorization check, so a crafted serialized object with an arbitrary __reduce__ runs OS commands as the service account with no credentials. Structural read: the ML attack surface has dropped below the model/inference engine into the data-and-metadata plane. NOTE for today: a fresh continuation needs a NEW state-change — a NEW named ML-registry/feature-store/metadata CVE, evidence of in-the-wild exploitation, a vendor shipping a deserialization scanner, or a patch-adoption/telemetry datapoint. A restatement of the same Feast advisory with no new fact must be DROPPED under ADR-002 Rule 2.
